application.description: Order tracker used by twelve named testers from one customer while the team decides whether to launch it publicly.
application.name: Acme Orders

compensating_controls.description: The API hostname sits behind an identity-aware proxy that only lets the twelve named testers' verified identities through; requests without a session never reach the database API.
compensating_controls.enforced_by: Cloudflare Access policy acme-orders-pilot (allowlist of twelve identities), owned by founder:mari

context.data_summary: Names, emails, delivery addresses and order lines of the pilot testers' own customers. No card data (hosted checkout).

claim.aspect: reachability of the data API from outside the tester allowlist
claim.statement: The requirement of No data readable/writable by an unauthenticated/anon caller unless intended public is met

evidence.scope: The exported Access policy on 16 August 2026, plus one unauthenticated request from outside the allowlist that the proxy rejected. Covers the proxied hostname only; it says nothing about the Supabase project's own hostname.

claim.statement: The requirement of No data readable/writable by an unauthenticated/anon caller unless intended public is met

evidence.scope: Anon reads of public.orders are denied on a table separately established as non-empty. The anon INSERT path was not exercised: that needs explicit write-probe consent, which was not given.

claim.statement: The requirement of Primary data store fits the workload and hosting model: managed persistent DB for multi-user data; no SQLite/JSON-file/localStorage as system of record on serverless or ephemeral hosting is met; The requirement of Stack choices are mainstream and maintainable: widely-used language, framework and database with documentation, community and hireable developers is met; The requirement of Authentication is a proven provider or library (Supabase Auth, Firebase, Auth0, NextAuth, Clerk, etc.); no hand-rolled password hashing, session tokens or JWT schemes is met; The requirement of Privileged/admin actions enforced server-side (Critical where admin functions are meaningful) is met; The requirement of Object-level authorization: users cannot reach records they don't own (IDOR) is met; The requirement of Authorization enforced server-side, default-deny is met; The requirement of Tenant isolation: no cross-tenant data access is met; The requirement of Account ownership: domain, hosting, DB, email, payment and AI-provider accounts owned by you/your company is met; The requirement of Continuity: someone other than the original builder can access, deploy, restore and maintain the app is met; The requirement of No unbounded loops / recursive agent steps; max-steps enforced is met; The requirement of Hard budget caps + billing alerts on every paid provider is met; The requirement of Expensive endpoints require auth; unauthenticated search/query bounded is met; The requirement of Quotas, per-user budgets, per-operation maximums, timeouts and concurrency caps on paid/LLM work is met; The requirement of No silent destructive migrations on prod; rollback/forward-recovery plan exists is met; The requirement of Backups configured, encrypted, access-controlled - and a restore has actually been tested (RPO/RTO known) is met; The requirement of CORS allows only intended origins/methods/headers; credentialed cross-origin narrowly restricted and tested is met; The requirement of Debug off in prod; verbose error pages disabled; no source maps/debug endpoints in public build is met; The requirement of Prod vs dev/staging config & data separated; no prod secrets in preview builds is met; The requirement of Output encoded per context (HTML/attr/JS/URL); HTML sanitized only when intentionally allowed; dangerous URL schemes blocked is met; The requirement of Server-side validation on all inputs is met; The requirement of All DB queries use parameter binding / safe query API; raw fragments & dynamic identifiers allowlisted is met; The requirement of Idempotency + retry/backoff + dead-letter handling on payment/order/webhook handlers is met; The requirement of Inbound webhooks verify signatures + timestamp; endpoint rejects unrelated event types is met; The requirement of LLM output never reaches an exec/eval/shell/SQL sink without validation/schema is met; The requirement of Tool-call authorisation based on the authenticated user, not model output; tools allowlisted; args validated; high-impact actions need human confirmation is met; The requirement of Untrusted content is separated and identified as data; it cannot modify trusted instructions/permissions/policy is met; The requirement of Concurrency safe: idempotency beyond payments, optimistic concurrency / stale-write handling, transactional boundaries is met; The requirement of Invariants + DB constraints enforce core rules; state-machine transitions validated is met; The requirement of Money/tax/currency: integer/decimal math, rounding rules, locale handling is met; The requirement of No stack traces / internal errors leaked to users is met; The requirement of PII not leaking into logs, analytics, or LLM prompts; provider retention/training settings reviewed is met; The requirement of Passwords never stored plaintext; sensitive data encrypted; tokens hashed is met; The requirement of Data truly persists (verified in the datastore) is met; The requirement of Behaviour matches the documented product claim; mocks/fixtures/fallbacks not presented as live output is met; The requirement of Payment account, keys, webhooks AND mode match the intended deployment environment is met; The requirement of Any exposed active credential treated as an incident: rotated, sessions revoked, logs inspected, removed from history is met; The requirement of No provider key prefixes shipped to client (sk-, AKIA, service_role, etc.) is met; The requirement of No secret-like literals in frontend source is met; The requirement of No secrets in current tree, git history, or public build bundle (.env excluded from VCS) is met; The requirement of Secrets injected securely at runtime; not in code/images/logs; access restricted; rotation supported is met; The requirement of Automated checks for auth + authorization/tenant separation is met; The requirement of Automated checks for the primary business transaction and destructive actions is met

evidence.scope: One reviewer walkthrough of the working tree and the Supabase project settings on 16 August 2026. Covers what could be seen in that session and nothing beyond it.

claim.statement: The requirement of Error tracking on client AND server; structured logs with correlation IDs; secrets/PII redacted is met

evidence.scope: Current working tree only, ruleset obs.no_error_tracking. No Sentry, Bugsnag or equivalent client found in the dependency manifest.
